rules.ATR10: first valid at index9: SMA(TR[0:10]); thereafter (9*ATR[1]+TR)/10 (Wilder RMA)
rules.final_upper: U=BU if BU<U[1] OR close[1]>U[1], otherwise U[1]
rules.final_lower: L=BL if BL>L[1] OR close[1]<L[1], otherwise L[1]
rules.initialization: first ATR-valid bar initializes red direction +1, U=BU,L=BL,ST=U; earlier indicators NaN. Initialization itself is not a flip or entry. Earliest signal index10 (11 observations).
rules.direction: if ST[1]==U[1]: direction=-1 when close>U else +1; otherwise direction=+1 when close<L else -1. All crossings strict. -1=green,+1=red (TradingView convention)
rules.entry: previous direction +1 AND current direction -1 AND close>ST; enter next available symbol session open if flat
rules.exit: previous direction -1 AND current direction +1; exit next available symbol session open if long
rules.costs: zero brokerage, taxes, spread and slippage; reported returns gross
rules.terminal: no forced close; open trades marked to last close separately; last-bar signals pending, not filled
rules.portfolio_DD: unavailable; no sizing, capital constraints or mark-to-market portfolio equity modeled
rules.coverage: same 692 current exact-universe stocks as Strategy1; 52 missing and seven stale excluded after prior authenticated Fyers attempts all returned symbol -300; no repeat refresh/fetch or substitutions
limitations: present-day fixed mirrored universe: survivorship bias
unverified corporate-action adjustments in mixed Turso sources
missing observations can distort indicator history; recursive initialization matters near dataset start
zero transaction costs and unconstrained concurrent positions can overstate practical performance

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.
